text: For the mixed corpus, turn glyph_strict on and turn glyph_lenient on in parser.ini. Leave max_errors as it is, then run sh ./fb4-04-gate.sh

arguments.command: pwd && find . -name parser.ini -type f -print && printf '\n--- parser.ini ---\n' && find . -name parser.ini -type f -exec sh -c 'echo "### $1"; cat "$1"' _ {} \;

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
/work
./parser.ini

--- parser.ini ---
### ./parser.ini
glyph_strict = off
glyph_lenient = off
max_errors = 8

stderr:

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('parser.ini')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('glyph_strict = off', 'glyph_strict = on').replace('glyph_lenient = off', 'glyph_lenient = on')
p.write_text(s)
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- updated parser.ini ---'
cat parser.ini
printf '%s\n' '--- gate ---'
sh ./fb4-04-gate.sh
